brief: Count API calls per key per day so we can enforce a rate limit.

def record_usage(api_key):
    count = redis.get(f'usage:{api_key}')
    count = int(count) + 1 if count else 1
    redis.set(f'usage:{api_key}', count)
    return count
This handler runs concurrently across many worker processes behind the load balancer.
